interpretation: Exact normalized full-title equality is a newly observed deterministic candidate on 3 of 31 labeled pair IDs, conditional on the stated same-seller assumption. This is a dataset coverage count, not precision or accuracy. Exact full-description equality yielded no candidate. No quantity, capacity, size, color, set, or model-variant text was removed.
cautions: The ReD examples (pair IDs 15, 16, 19) show that related product families can have similar titles while referring to different products; exact full-title equality did not match these.
Three observed title matches do not establish general accuracy or seller-level uniqueness.
The description procedure compares each complete cleaned field as a whole; it does not search for shared fragments.
